original_value: Deep learning is making major breakthrough in several areas of bioinformatics. Anticipating that this will occur soon for the single‐cell RNA‐seq data analysis, we review newly published deep learning methods that help tackle computational challenges. Autoencoders are found to be the dominant approach. However, methods based on deep generative models such as generative adversarial networks (GANs) are also emerging in this area.

result.paraphrase: Deep learning has been achieving major breakthroughs across several areas of bioinformatics. Expecting this to soon happen in single-cell RNA-seq data analysis, we review recently published deep learning methods that address computational challenges. Autoencoders are the dominant approach. However, deep generative model methods such as generative adversarial networks (GANs) are also beginning to emerge in this area.
